name: pbpk_renal_impairment_chain
display_name: PBPK Simulation — Allometric Scaling & Special Populations
description: Mechanistic PBPK simulation for predicting human pharmacokinetics from preclinical animal data. Step 1: allometric scaling to estimate human PK parameters from rat, mouse, or dog data. Step 2: full PBPK simulation with compartmental model and organ-specific clearance (optional renal/hepatic impairment submodel for special population dosing). Step 3: virtual patient cohort Monte Carlo sampling for variability characterization. Use for: species scaling, IND/NDA PBPK packages, first-in-human dose projection, and special population (renal/hepatic impairment) dose adjustments. Required for regulatory PBPK submissions (EMA PBPK guideline, FDA PBPK reporting format).
